nodes.description: External caller-controlled address (msg.sender) used as depositor, borrower, redeemer and owner/admin identity.
Miner-influenceable block.timestamp used for interest accrual, event metadata and lastUpdateTimestamp writes.
ReentrancyGuard mutex counter incremented and compared inside the nonReentrant modifier.
Owner address stored by Ownable, initialised from msg.sender in the constructor.
EIP-1967 storage slot holding the proxy implementation address.
EIP-1967 storage slot holding the proxy admin address.
Mapping(address => CoreLibrary.ReserveData) keeping per-reserve protocol state.
Mapping(user => reserve => UserReserveData) keeping per-user borrow state.
AddressStorage mapping(bytes32 => address) registry used by LendingPoolAddressesProvider.
LendingPool.deposit: external payable nonReentrant entry point that mints aTokens and moves funds to the core.
LendingPool.redeemUnderlying: nonReentrant entry point called by the aToken to transfer underlying back to the user.
LendingPool.borrow: nonReentrant entry point validating collateral then disbursing funds to the user.
LendingPool.repay: payable nonReentrant entry point returning debt and fees to the protocol.
LendingPool.flashLoan: nonReentrant function that lends liquidity and calls an arbitrary receiver contract.
LendingPool.liquidationCall: payable nonReentrant entry point delegating to the liquidation manager.
LendingPoolCore.transferToUser: onlyLendingPool function that sends ERC20 or ETH to a user.
LendingPoolCore.transferToFeeCollectionAddress: payable onlyLendingPool function moving fees to the distributor.
LendingPoolCore.transferToReserve: payable onlyLendingPool function pulling user funds and refunding excess ETH.
LendingPoolCore.updateStateOnBorrow: onlyLendingPool state transition for a borrow action.
CoreLibrary.calculateLinearInterest: computes accrued interest from block.timestamp and lastUpdateTimestamp.
LendingPoolCore internal that mutates the user borrow record and its lastUpdateTimestamp.
Ownable.transferOwnership: onlyOwner function updating the owner address.
Ownable.renounceOwnership: onlyOwner function clearing the owner address.
BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.changeAdmin: ifAdmin function rewriting the ADMIN_SLOT.
BaseAdminUpgradeabilityProxy.upgradeToAndCall: payable ifAdmin function performing a delegatecall after upgrade.
ReentrancyGuard.nonReentrant modifier that guards pool entry points with _guardCounter.
VersionedInitializable initializer entry point that wires the addresses provider dependency.
Low-level ETH transfer (_user.call.value(_amount).gas(50000)("")) inside transferToUser.
Low-level ETH transfer to the fee destination inside transferToFeeCollectionAddress.
Low-level ETH refund (_user.call.value(excessAmount)) inside transferToReserve.
delegatecall from LendingPool to the externally configured liquidation manager.
delegatecall to the newly set implementation with caller supplied data.
Inline assembly sstore writing the implementation address into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
External call to receiver.executeOperation granting execution control to an arbitrary contract.
Inline assembly extcodesize used by Address.isContract for contract existence checks.
_amount parameter of deposit, the underlying amount deposited by the user.
BorrowLocalVars memory struct holding intermediate borrow computation results.
_reserve parameter of deposit, the reserve address targeted by the action.
currentAvailableLiquidity local holding the reserve liquidity before a redeem.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the depositor for minting aTokens in deposit.
msg.sender is passed as the redeeming user inside redeemUnderlying.
msg.sender is the borrower whose global data is validated in borrow.
msg.sender is the repayer compared against _onBehalfOf in repay.
The Ownable constructor sets _owner directly from msg.sender, defining the privileged role.
The ifAdmin modifier compares msg.sender with the stored admin before privileged writes.
block.timestamp is used to derive accrued interest during the borrow state update.
Interest computation depends on block.timestamp minus the stored lastUpdateTimestamp.
block.timestamp is cast to uint40 and stored as the user lastUpdateTimestamp.
block.timestamp is emitted in the Deposit event of the deposit function.
The nonReentrant modifier increments and checks _guardCounter to block nested calls.
transferOwnership modifies the _owner state variable under onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership clears the _owner state variable under onlyOwner.
_transferOwnership writes the new owner into _owner after a zero-address check.
The assembly sstore writes the new implementation into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
changeAdmin rewrites the admin address stored in ADMIN_SLOT.
updateStateOnBorrow reads and mutates the reserves mapping for the target reserve.
updateUserStateOnBorrowInternal writes principal, fee and timestamp into usersReserveData.
deposit calls core.transferToReserve.value(msg.value) to move the deposited funds.
redeemUnderlying calls core.transferToUser to return the underlying asset.
borrow calls core.updateStateOnBorrow before disbursing the loan.
borrow calls core.transferToUser to send the borrowed amount to the borrower.
repay calls core.transferToFeeCollectionAddress when fees are being settled.
repay calls core.transferToReserve.value(...) to move the repaid principal.
flashLoan transfers funds then invokes the receiver executeOperation callback.
liquidationCall forwards execution to the liquidation manager via delegatecall.
upgradeToAndCall performs a delegatecall on the new implementation with supplied data.
updateStateOnBorrow invokes updateUserStateOnBorrowInternal to persist user data.
updateStateOnBorrow triggers cumulative index updates that use calculateLinearInterest.
The user lastUpdateTimestamp is derived from block.timestamp during borrow.
The user record is written into the usersReserveData mapping.
transferToUser falls back to a low-level call.value transfer for ETH reserves.
transferToFeeCollectionAddress performs a low-level call.value to the fee destination.
transferToReserve refunds excess ETH through a low-level call.value to the user.
The sstore operation persists the implementation address into IMPLEMENTATION_SLOT.
_setImplementation validates the new implementation address with Address.isContract (extcodesize).
Sending ETH to a user with call.value transfers control and can reenter redeemUnderlying handling.
The fee destination low-level call can reenter repay before settlement completes.
The excess ETH refund callback to the user can reenter repay accounting.
The flashloan receiver reenters flashLoan logic before the availableLiquidityAfter consistency check.
The delegatecall target (liquidation manager) executes arbitrary external logic within the pool context.
The delegatecall on the new implementation can execute attacker-influenced code during the upgrade call.
_amount parameter feeds the aToken minting and core transfer inside deposit.
BorrowLocalVars holds collateral, fee and rate values computed in borrow.
_reserve parameter selects the reserve manipulated by deposit.
currentAvailableLiquidity gates the redeem amount check in redeemUnderlying.

normalization_plan.reason: _amount is only meaningful as the input amount of the deposit function and carries no independent state.
BorrowLocalVars is a stack-too-deep helper struct whose lifetime is entirely confined to borrow.
_reserve is the function-scoped reserve selector used only during the deposit call.
currentAvailableLiquidity is a temporary local used only for the liquidity check in redeemUnderlying.
